question: How does this Agreement renew, and how much notice is needed to stop it?
ground_truth_answer: The Agreement has an initial one (1) year term, automatically renewing for successive one (1) year terms unless either party gives forty-five (45) days' notice of non-renewal.

expected_citations.span_hint: This Agreement has an initial term of one (1) year, automatically renewing for successive one (1) year terms unless either party provides forty-five (45) days' notice of non-renewal.
